purpose: Dev-time debug helper: format an int as a decimal string, print the value and its string length, then wait for a keypress.

Dead code: 0 callers, 0 xrefs in the shipped binary -- a number-formatter trace left over from development.

params.name: value
params.semantics: The integer to format and display. Passed straight into sprintf(buf, "%d", value); its decimal text and that text's strlen are printed.
params.reason: Accurately describes the sole input (the value being formatted/printed); no address residue, not a param_N placeholder.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is console output plus a blocking getch().
